profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at NetApp
profile.summary: Professional developer with excellent communication skills. Experienced in cloud based solutions for storage and SAN network systems. Originally trained in scientific and high performance computing.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Development and usage of a forward model in order to parameterize the
COSMO-SAC platform using heterogeneous/GPU computing.

Enhancement of the first principles in the physics of COSMO-RS and
COSMO-SAC models, this will develop a new approach in the theory that will
provide a more robust foundation. This involves Quantum and Statistical
mechanical calculations. 

Computational implementation of the new developed COSMO approach into a design
paradigm (COSMO-Design), in order to design/discover new species for a broad
applications in chemical industry.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching assitantship in Advanced Transport Phenomena class (graduate level). Duties included:
grading, offering office hours, and teaching the Mathematica computer language.

Teaching assitantship in Capstone Project. Duties included:
grading, offering office hours, and teaching the Aspen Suite
computational simulation platform. (2 consecutive semesters)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Development and usage of an efficient single molecule assay for the mechanical and fluorescent studies of T Cell Receptors (TCRs).

Construction and development of a coarse grained model for the simulation of Kinesin based motor proteins motility on Microtubule during Cell division.

Contributed to the Drug Design Protocol in Rosetta Commons by implementing morphological perturbations to long-chained molecules in order to reduce entropic penalties.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching assitantship in Unit operations laboratory. Duties included:
Setting up the equipment and material needed in the laboratory, grading and
supervising student group performance.

Teaching assitantship in Separation Processes class. Duties included:
grading and offering office hours to students in order to mentor and
evaluate their academic performance.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Simulating hydrating 3-D Alite microstructures using dynamic nonlinear
autoregressive (NAR) Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), using time series 3-D
virtual microstructure data.

Generation of a hybrid model that couples continuum and stochastic
approaches for the simulation of 3-D hydrating Alite microstructures
(approach for wall time speed-up).

Development of a multi-core parallel prototype that emulates hydrating
3-D Alite microstructures using a Stochastic Cellular Automaton approach.

company.name: Tennessee Tech University - Student to Career

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Developed an automated computational protocol that emulates the change in volumetric distribution within a prototyped sports marine vehicle fuel tank. This project was performed as a part time project in an academia/industry collaboration.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developed computer code to find optimal axial temperature profiles for
three different case studies using convex optimization algorithms. The case
studies were: elementary kinetics of a single gasification reaction,
elementary kinetics of multiple parallel and synchronized reactions, and
kinetics on parallel reactions under the Langmuir Hinshelwood model.

Studied the behavior of continuum chemical reactors under the impose of
external axial temperature profiles. Four case studies were approached:
convex profile, Gaussian profile, linear and constant profile.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching assitantship in Optimization of Chemical processes. Duties were:
grading and teaching computational techniques for library usage in linear
and nonlinear programming in the computational languages MATLAB and GAMS.
